fact: The presentation reports electronic birth registration (EBRS) in 78 of 585 health facilities and all 28 districts by 2024, village-head community registration still completely paper based, and under-five birth registration at about 85% by 2025 (UNICEF, 2025).
title: Building Legal Identity from Birth: Good Practices and Digital Innovations in Malawi's CRVS System
publisher: UNDP (Ritu Kumar Mishra), CART 2025-2026 / UNESCAP CRVS
